name: PowerShell Spawning Reconnaissance Commands
query: Channel:Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational AND (event.code:1 AND (ParentImage:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\powershell_ise.exe)) AND (Image:(*\\whoami.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\wmic.exe)))
